answer_1.quote: We tackle the problem of taking the relevant section in the conversations corresponding to the care plan as input and automatically derive care plan instructions that the medical professionals can approve.
datasets: internal primary care dialogue-careplan dataset (14K encounters, 48K source‑reference pairs)
models: Utilization‑regularized models (Unweighted, Concept weighted, Semantic weighted)

answer_2.quote: We use BERTScore to estimate the similarity between reference and candidate, GPT-2 perplexity for ... to assess the coherence (fluency) of the candidate, and concept overlap to measure the percentage of medical concepts used in both candidate and reference.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation with medical experts. We randomly sample 100 dialogues from the test set and generate candidates with each model... We ask five doctors to evaluate the relevance to the dialogue, medical usability (if the generated instruction can be used in any care plan), and grammatical correctness (fluency) on a scale from 1 to 5. Additionally, we ask assessors to indicate degenerate generations.
answer_4.guideline: Medical experts rate each generated instruction on relevance, medical usability, fluency, and indicate whether the output is degenerate.
